name: design-prototype-tools
description: The .fig <-> HTML pipeline shipped by the design-prototype skill. This manifest declares what the tools need; it is installed in the target prototype, never in this repository.
//: The versions the tools were originally developed against could not be determined:
there was no lockfile, no node_modules and no version recorded in any comment or
document. These are therefore the current releases as resolved from the registry on
2026-07-27, pinned to their major so a breaking bump cannot arrive silently.
kiwi-schema matters most: it is a 0.x package, so the caret pins the minor as well,
which is what this pipeline wants — a change in what the encoder emits shows up as
Figma hanging at '0 of 1 files' with no error message.
The Node floor is >=22: the shipped generator needs zlib.zstdCompressSync and
the executable-quality gate uses Node's native --experimental-test-coverage.
No patch-level floor is claimed because none was verified.

scripts.test: node test-usecases-contract.js && node test-product-contract.js && node test-mobile.js
